- **Report catalog gaps only on explicit request.** Send feedback only when the user explicitly asks for that report. If telemetry is disabled or the user opted out, do not send it. Search results, a completed render and tool warnings are not requests to send feedback. A search-gap report includes the user's brief-derived query and wanted move. `HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY` covers anonymous counters, not this command. After an explicit request, use `pnpm exec hyperframes feedback --search-miss "<the query you ran>" --wanted "<the move you needed>" --tier <the tier that answered>`. The `report_gap` field is a command suggestion, not consent.{{marker}}
